svg.aria-label: Hostty adds a domain, then shows a Rails server, a Jekyll site, and Solid Queue in tabs, with the URL of each domain in the tab bar and a line of output selected for copying, then a scroll up through the job output and a drag down past the bottom edge that copies many lines, then the web tab blinks yellow when a debugger call rings the bell, and three little ghosts float by before the demo starts over
